title: Canada and United Arab Emirates ministers discuss regional security and cooperation
excerpt: Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand met with Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan in Abu Dhabi to discuss bilateral ties and regional stability.
bodyHtml:
The Honourable Anita Anand, Minister of Foreign Affairs, met with His Highness Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the United Arab Emirates, on October 16, 2026, in Abu Dhabi. The meeting focused on the ongoing partnership between the two nations.

Minister Anand stated that Canada stands in solidarity with the United Arab Emirates and other Gulf partners regarding attacks on their territory. She emphasized the importance of diplomatic de-escalation and regional security. The ministers reaffirmed their commitment to future cooperation in sectors including trade, investment, defence, artificial intelligence, and innovation.

The ministers agreed to remain in close contact following their discussions.
